sources.title: The Tamagotchi Paradise Universe Expands with New Shells, Collectibles | The Toy Insider
sources.snippet:
Visit a frozen landscape with the Tamagotchi Paradise White Glacier design. | Source: Bandai Namco Toys & Collectibles America

The two new worlds, Orange Tropics and White Glacier, feature new Tamas, new minigames for kids to play alongside their digital pets and friends during the connection function, and bigger fields for more Tamas! [...] The Tamagotchi Paradise: Orange Tropics and White Glacier shells are available now to preorder on Amazon. The full expansion will be available for families to purchase in stores and online in July. Parents and caregivers can learn more about the latest Tamagotchi Paradise toys at tamagotchi-official.com.

## TAMAGOTCHI PARADISE: ORANGE TROPICS & WHITE GLACIER [...] Kids can also take their Tamagotchis on road trips and summer vacations with new lanyard colors inspired by the Orange Tropics and White Glacier. The Vivid Yellow and Pastel Pink lanyards will make it easier to keep track of their digital devices.

Kids can bring their favorite Tama along on all their adventures by clipping them on their bags. | Source: Bandai Namco Toys & Collectibles America

sources.title: Welcome to Paradise: New Devices and Must-Have Accessories | News | Official Tamagotchi Site
sources.snippet:
From the newest drops to the accessories everyone will be reaching for, here’s your inside look at what’s new and what deserves a spot in your collection.

🌺🧊Orange Tropics and White Glacier:

Two new fields are here! Hot and vibrant Orange Tropics is giving all the vacation vibes with its bright pink and orange combo, while White Glacier enchants with a frosty casing that shimmers in soft blue-purple hues! [...] Paradise Figure Set:     Is the ultimate collector's item! Packaged in a blister card that tells the story of Paradise, the set comes with 1 known figure, a UFO case, 1 blind figure to keep the excitement going, and a sticker to customize. The perfect set for any Tama fan looking to level up their collectibles collection! Available for Land, Water, and Sky! What Tama will you reveal? [...] Paradise Volume 1:     These adorable little Tamas are a must-have for any fan! Coming as a blind bag, each collectible features a Paradise Tama tucked inside a UFO case with a ball chain; perfect for displaying or carrying wherever you go. Inspired by land, sky, water and forest themes, there's a whole world of characters to discover; and every unboxing is a surprise!
